name: Iki-Tsushima Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Iki and Tsushima islands in the Korea strait, with sea cliffs, shrine history and the fortified legacy of the island borders.
notes: Managed by Nagasaki. Ferries from Hakata reach both islands.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
